symptom: A metadata mutation left the newest FULL history head incomplete. A sealed stop/resume rebuilt from that head and erased the earlier local transcript despite a valid paired NORMAL checkpoint.
rule: The bug-fix loop verifies real sealed stores and the exact authenticated FULL/NORMAL pair. An incomplete latest fence is not evidence of an empty transcript; preserve exact sealed rows without borrowing older or unsealed custody, retain real prune/delete effects, and restore oversized chats and siblings without a total local-history cap. Stream rows inside the destination transaction through the final source custody check.
